title: Patient Management CRUD Operations
description: Verify that patient records can be created, read, updated, and deleted with proper data validation and duplication checks.

steps.description: Navigate to patient creation page.
Create a new patient with valid data including medical history and media attachments.
Verify that the patient record is saved and appears in the patient list.
Open the created patient details page and edit patient data.
Verify updates are reflected correctly and data validation prevents invalid entries.
Attempt to create another patient with duplicate identifying information.
Verify that duplication is detected and the system prevents creation.
Delete the created patient.
Verify the patient is removed from the system and cannot be accessed.

title: Multi-Therapist Scheduling with Conflict Prevention
description: Validate appointment scheduling that supports multiple therapists including conflict checking and recurring appointments.

steps.description: Navigate to the scheduling page.
Schedule an appointment for Therapist A and Therapist B at the same time slot.
Verify the appointment is successfully created with both therapists assigned.
Attempt to schedule an overlapping appointment for Therapist A.
Verify the system blocks the appointment due to scheduling conflict.
Create a recurring appointment series for Therapist B.
Verify all recurring appointments appear correctly in the schedule and can be managed.
Modify one occurrence from the recurring series.
Verify the single occurrence updates without affecting the series.

title: Clinical Documentation with Rich Text and Auto-Save
description: Ensure SOAP notes support rich text editing, auto-save, version control, and template usage.

steps.description: Open a new SOAP note for a patient session.
Enter clinical data using rich text formatting features like bold, italic, bullet lists.
Verify formatting appears correctly and input is saved periodically by auto-save.
Load a SOAP note template and edit its contents.
Confirm the template loads correctly and changes can be saved as new notes.
Edit the note multiple times to generate version history.
Verify that version control tracks changes and users can revert to previous versions.

title: AI Assistant Generates Reports and Treatment Suggestions
description: Test Google Gemini AI integration for automatic generation of clinical reports, treatment suggestions, and risk analyses with at least 95% accuracy.

steps.description: Open AI assistant interface and request a clinical report based on patient session data.
Verify the generated report is comprehensive, relevant to input data, and free of critical errors.
Use AI to get suggested treatment protocols for a patient condition.
Confirm treatment suggestions align with clinical guidelines and are personalized to patient data.
Request risk analysis for a specific patient case using AI assistant.
Verify risk factors are accurately identified and appropriate alerts or notes are generated.
Test AI performance on edge cases such as incomplete patient data.
Ensure AI handles incomplete data gracefully with warnings or fallbacks.

title: Exercise Library Content and Personalized Prescription
description: Verify exercise library contains categorized and media-rich content and supports personalized exercise prescriptions.

steps.description: Browse exercise library applying filters by category and difficulty.
Verify the filtered list shows appropriate exercises and media like images/videos load correctly.
Create a personalized exercise plan by selecting exercises with notes.
Confirm the plan is saved and associated with the patient correctly.
Send personalized prescription to patient's portal.
Verify the patient can view and interact with prescribed exercises in their portal.

title: Patient Portal Secure Access and Data Presentation
description: Ensure the patient portal securely authenticates users and provides real-time access to health data, exercise plans, and appointments.

steps.description: Attempt to log in to the patient portal with valid credentials.
Verify login is successful and patient-specific data loads.
Attempt login with invalid credentials.
Verify access is denied with appropriate error messages.
Check that the patient portal presents up-to-date medical history, active exercise plans, and upcoming appointments.
Verify data consistency and correctness.
Attempt unauthorized access to data of another patient.
Verify access is forbidden and session does not leak other patient information.

title: Interactive Dashboards and Exportable Reports
description: Validate dashboards display accurate operational and clinical metrics with interactive visualization and support data export.

steps.description: Navigate to dashboard views for operational, clinical, and financial data.
Verify KPI cards and charts load accurately with correct data.
Interact with filters, date ranges, and drill-down features on charts.
Confirm the visualizations update correctly and maintain performance.
Export reports to common formats such as PDF and CSV.
Verify exported files are complete, well formatted, and match displayed data.

title: Financial Management with Payment Tracking and Multi-Payment Integration
description: Test financial management features including payment tracking, revenue reports, and multi-payment methods like PIX and credit cards.

steps.description: Record payments for patient invoices using PIX and credit card methods.
Verify payment status updates correctly and payments are logged with method details.
Generate revenue reports for selected date ranges.
Confirm reports accurately sum transactions and reflect filtered criteria.
Test edge cases such as partial payments and failed transactions.
Verify system handles exceptions, updates balances appropriately, and notifies users.

title: Inventory Control with Stock Alerts and Movement History
description: Validate inventory system tracks stock movements, generates alerts on threshold breaches, and maintains accurate history.

steps.description: Add new inventory items and update stock quantities.
Verify stock levels update and movement history logs changes accurately.
Simulate consumption to reduce stock below alert threshold.
Verify that alert notifications are triggered and visible in the system.
Review movement history for selected item.
Confirm all adjustments are timestamped and associated with user actions.

title: Communication CRM with WhatsApp Integration
description: Test the CRM system's ability to send notifications and messages via WhatsApp and manage patient communications.

steps.description: Open the CRM interface and select a patient contact.
Send a WhatsApp message notification to the patient.
Verify the message is sent successfully and status is updated in CRM.
Receive a WhatsApp response message from the patient.
Confirm the incoming message appears in the CRM chat history in real time.
Test bulk notification sending and verify recipients receive individual messages.
Ensure bulk message sending processes correctly and reports delivery statuses.

title: Teleconsultation Functionality including Video Conferencing and Session History
description: Verify the teleconsultation system supports video calls, scheduling, and preserves session histories for review.

steps.description: Schedule a teleconsultation appointment for a patient and clinician.
Verify appointment appears in calendars and reminders are sent.
Start a video consultation session at the scheduled time.
Confirm video and audio streams are active, stable, and participants can communicate.
End the session and save session notes.
Ensure session history including video metadata and notes is properly stored and accessible.
Attempt to join a session as an unauthorized user.
Verify access is denied and security controls prevent unauthorized entry.

title: Gamification System for Patient Engagement
description: Test gamification features including achievements, points accumulation, and challenges to enhance patient engagement.

steps.description: Complete prescribed exercise to trigger achievement unlock.
Verify achievement is awarded and reflected in patient dashboard.
Accumulate points over multiple completed tasks.
Confirm points tally updates correctly and leaderboards refresh.
Start and complete a challenge.
Validate challenge completion status updates and associated rewards are granted.

title: Educational Materials Library Functionality
description: Ensure educational materials (videos, articles) are accessible, categorized, and searchable for professionals and patients.

steps.description: Browse materials library by category and keyword search.
Verify search results and categories return relevant materials.
Open several educational videos and articles.
Confirm media plays properly and articles render without format issues.
Test access permissions for materials restricted to professional users.
Validate access control enforces restrictions properly.

title: Secure Authentication with Role-Based Access and Password Recovery
description: Test user registration, login, role-based access control, and password recovery workflows with security standards compliance.

steps.description: Register a new user with a specified role (patient, therapist, admin).
Validate registration succeeds with strong password enforcement and sends verification emails if applicable.
Log in as the new user and verify access to role-appropriate features.
Confirm unauthorized areas are blocked and access control is enforced.
Perform password recovery via email link.
Validate password reset process completes securely and user can log in with new password.
Attempt login with incorrect credentials multiple times.
Verify account lockout or CAPTCHA mechanisms activate to prevent brute-force attacks.

title: LGPD Compliance with Data Encryption, Audit Logs, and Access Controls
description: Verify compliance with LGPD including encryption of personal data, auditing user actions, and enforcing role-based data access.

steps.description: Access patient personal data as an authorized user.
Confirm data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Attempt to access patient data with a user lacking required role.
Verify access is denied and appropriate error messages are returned.
Perform action logs such as creating, modifying, and deleting records.
Verify audit logs capture user id, timestamp, and action details and logs are immutable.

title: Performance Testing for Page Load and System Availability
description: Test that system meets performance metrics including sub-2-second page loads and at least 99.5% availability.

steps.description: Load key pages such as patient list, dashboard, and scheduling interfaces under normal and peak load conditions.
Measure and verify page load times are consistently under 2 seconds.
Simulate high concurrent user load on critical system modules.
Confirm system remains responsive without crashes and maintains 99.5% uptime.
Test recovery processes after intentional system failure or restart.
Verify system restores state correctly and is available within acceptable time frame.
